# Bounded inspector-hook reproduction: no failure reproduced

This supplements, and does not overwrite, `profile-pointer-diagnosis.md`. Root authorized only a no-Cargo diagnostic with the already-built binary. F2 owned the shared target for its app check; this task only read and executed the existing hashed test binary.

## Actual results

- Source HEAD `4b13b64a0f4556470cbf6b7a5e1c7f1b000d0f50`, staged tree `1e76097a22d620a9f3839ff0c0d49f1f3d636d68`, unchanged after diagnosis.
- Full bounded interval: 2026-09-15T01:49:17.1226220Z to 01:49:23.4612518Z. Wrapper PID 20384, outer exit 0. Every individual test command exit was 0.
- Exact pointer test in a fresh process with `QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR=1`: 1 passed, 2074 filtered. Hook sensitivity did not reproduce in this run.
- Hook/pointer pair, two libtest filters, `--test-threads=2 --nocapture`: exactly 20 fresh-process attempts, each 2 passed / 2073 filtered. No failures, so the predetermined maximum ended the run. No extension or retry-until-green occurred.
- Total: 21 fresh test processes, 41 test executions. This is not 41 distinct tests.
- SHA256 of the binary was checked before every process: `A2D7AADF0E084D66FE5343EABBE4E7C47DC8FE5B6A59D1647297C62CCAE45053`.
- Process-local committed bubbles fixture SHA256 remained `5DB6B44A4564F7E0CD26482A3F1BADD17EB41788E6959453330F2738BB37CD4D`; Cargo.lock SHA256 `8826F73F0589B91F318C40316C18C1925B926BD7A03C0DDB393CA0A84EC795FA`.
- The inspector hook was absent on wrapper entry. The wrapper set it only for the exact-test child and removed it from its own environment before the paired children. The pair's existing hook test mutated only its own fresh test process. No machine/user environment setting or user configuration was written.
- At 01:49:45.4235430Z, read-only checks found wrapper PID 20384 absent and zero processes with the diagnostic binary name. A separate shell had no inspector variable. The shared build target remains released to F2.

## Evidence

Full scoped tool result, including commands, per-process start/end, environment delta, input hashes and all output: `profile-hook-reproduction.json`, SHA256 `EF958219E98670C049A5BC42B6169AE900BDC2B4903371129B5EDA74241D4A3A`. No truncation marker or omitted run.

Exact invoked script: `diagnose-profile-hook.ps1`, SHA256 `9184A5EA5F2B5D65E70EAFF715D6E9B376C4AB09AFCF0FDCB9976AF73639B487`.

Successful wrapper command:

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 'C:/src/quantick/.git/worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows/evidence/diagnose-profile-hook.ps1'
```

The execution-policy argument applies to this new process; no persistent execution policy was changed.

## Preserved invocation failures before the test run

1. Read-only precheck chunk `67ee76`, outer exit 1: binary/source hashes were printed successfully, but the final `Get-Date -AsUTC -Format o` failed because the host's Windows PowerShell lacks `-AsUTC`. No test ran. Subsequent script timestamps use `(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')`; no earlier timestamp is invented. Raw error excerpt:

```text
Get-Date : Não é possível localizar um parâmetro que coincida com o nome de parâmetro 'AsUTC'.
No linha:2 caractere:267
+ ... Continue; git rev-parse HEAD; git write-tree; Get-Date -AsUTC -Format ...
+                                                            ~~~~~~
    + CategoryInfo          : InvalidArgument: (:) [Get-Date], ParameterBindingException
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : NamedParameterNotFound,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.GetDateCommand
```

2. Direct script invocation was refused by the host execution policy, before the script or any test ran. Exact failed tool result: `profile-hook-launch-failure.json`, SHA256 `7BFD60EF44A8EB2E9E8D92333BD09FD1F540BE8F9A91257E3C6088D13CF5A678`, chunk `dbc7d8`, exit 1. The process-local command shown above then ran the unchanged script successfully. These are operational invocation errors, not additional test failures or product repairs.

## Interpretation and remaining work

The source-local mutex does not synchronize other readers of the process-wide hook, but this bounded experiment did not connect that defect to the historical pointer failure. Do not promote the speculative causal finding or repair unrelated source based on it. No failed-frame geometry, layer or constructor-overlap receipt exists.

Original acceptance status remains **FAIL**: the previous full workspace loop failed in the pointer test. Neither this experiment nor the earlier isolated passes clear it. A useful next diagnostic, only after root coordination, is one unchanged full app test-binary execution at default concurrency and one serial execution with the same fixture, not another open-ended pair loop. Any acceptance claim still requires the applicable complete ordered workspace verification and exact-head CI.
